Specification: This specification defines a module CyclicRedefine that extends Base and TLC and reuses operators from the embedded Base module text. The top-level module introduces redefined initialization, next-state, action, helper, and invariant operators around a single state variable x, with ReDefInit constraining x to BOOLEAN and requiring Init, ReDefNext combining Next with the negation of A(1), and ReDefA adding a Print side effect before invoking A(n). The file models simple boolean state transitions over x and includes state predicates and actions, but it does not define a temporal Spec operator, fairness conditions, or proofs.
